description: This file defines the Java class 'DeleteResource', which represents a command to delete a resource from a policy in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing data fields related to the delete resource operation.

classes.name: DeleteResource
classes.description: A command class that encapsulates the operation of deleting a resource from a policy, implementing the PolicyModifyCommand interface and extending AbstractCommand. It provides factory methods, JSON deserialization, and getters for associated data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteResource instance from policy ID as String, label, resource key, and headers (deprecated version).

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteResource instance from policy ID object, label, resource key, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteResource instance from a JSON string representation.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteResource instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry associated with the resource to delete.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the resource key of the resource to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this delete command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource within the policy.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload information to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteResource with updated Ditto headers.
